_note: Control set for the review prompt. Every 'bad' pair was found by reading stored work against its original; every 'good' pair is correct and must survive untouched. A prompt that does not catch the bad ones must not be dispatched — 238 000 pairs went out once on an untested prompt and came back with a 0.23% correction rate against a measured ~14% defect rate.

Latin letters inside the Russian word
